params.name: Method
params.description: How the sphere is tessellated: UV uses latitude rows and longitude columns, Icosphere subdivides an icosahedron into even triangles, Cube projects a gridded cube into quads.

params.name: Radius
params.description: Radius of the sphere in world units, the distance from Center to every point on its surface.

params.name: Rows
params.description: Number of latitude bands from pole to pole for the UV method. More rows give a smoother profile and more points.

params.name: Columns
params.description: Number of longitude segments around the UV sphere. More columns give a rounder silhouette and more points.

params.name: Frequency
params.description: How many times each icosahedron edge is divided for the Icosphere method; each of the 20 faces becomes Frequency squared triangles.

params.name: Resolution
params.description: Grid divisions along each edge of every cube face for the Cube method; each face gets Resolution squared quads.

params.name: Center X
params.description: X position of the sphere's center in world units.

params.name: Center Y
params.description: Y (height) position of the sphere's center in world units.

params.name: Center Z
params.description: Z position of the sphere's center in world units.

params.name: Color
params.description: When on, colors each point by its surface direction (normal mapped to RGB); when off, the sphere uses the plain default color.
